semantics.adequacy_evidence: KEVM d4bf484a's OSAKA schedule is PRAGUE + EIP-7939 (CLZ) only, with PRAGUE's precompile set (schedule.md: syntax Schedule ::= "OSAKA" [symbol(OSAKA_EVM), smtlib(schedule_OSAKA)] // ----------------------------------------------------------------------- rule [SCHEDCO...). Mainnet osaka execution-layer EIPs it does NOT model: EIP-7823/7883 (MODEXP bounds and repricing), EIP-7951 (P256VERIFY at 0x100), EIP-7825 (tx gas cap), EIP-7918 (blob base fee floor), EIP-7934 (block RLP size). KEVM's own declared-failing conformance list (tests/execution-spec-tests/failing.llvm, fixtures v5.4.0) has 498 of 743 entries on the Osaka fork, by test dir: cancun/eip4844_blobs 160, osaka/eip7883_modexp_gas_increase 146, static/state_tests 55, byzantium/eip198_modexp_precompile 29, osaka/eip7823_modexp_upper_bounds 18, osaka/eip7918_blob_reserve_price 18, osaka/eip7825_transaction_gas_limit_cap 13, osaka/eip7951_p256verify_precompiles 12, prague/eip7623_increase_calldata_cost 8, prague/eip7702_set_code_tx 7, shanghai/eip4895_withdrawals 7, prague/eip7002_el_triggerable_withdrawals 5. No pass/total was computed in this pilot (fixtures not in the tarball, not run). Record: provenance/kevm_osaka_adequacy.json.
semantics.adequacy_evidence_for_this_artifact: GemJoin uses no opcode introduced after Shanghai (linear sweep of the 3410-byte code section, CBOR trailer excluded: none of CLZ, BLOBHASH, BLOBBASEFEE, TLOAD, TSTORE, MCOPY; no SELFDESTRUCT, no BLOCKHASH), so the KEVM SHANGHAI/OSAKA differences reachable from its code are gas constants only, which no claim models. Record: provenance/opscan.json.

identity.constructor_and_immutables: none; runtime code only (solc 0.5.12 GemJoin has no immutables; vat/ilk/gem/dec are storage slots 1-4)

environment.fork_basis: the claims are proved under KEVM <schedule> OSAKA </schedule>; mainnet at the pinned block runs osaka execution rules (eth_config current.forkId 0x07c9462e, activationTime 1767747671 = BPO2 blob schedule {'baseFeeUpdateFraction': 11684671, 'max': 21, 'target': 14}, from 3 RPCs). KEVM OSAKA is a partial model of mainnet osaka (semantics[0].adequacy_evidence, A_osaka_model) and does not model the BPO blob parameters (A_blob_params).
environment.fee_schedule: not modelled: every claim runs with <useGas> false (Aasm-gas-abstraction); the KEVM OSAKA gas constants are present in the semantics but unused
environment.external_code_note: No proved path reaches a CALL (by bytecode inspection: the 4 CALLs sit in join/exit after the live check and the overflow guard), so WETH and Vat code are part of E for the deployed contract but no claim depends on their behaviour. A different gem/vat at the same slots would not change any claim.
environment.caller_assumptions: msg.sender arbitrary (any 160-bit address; claim-04 additionally: not a ward); GemJoin's code runs as the top-level frame under its own account; no DELEGATECALL into GemJoin; non-static; callvalue 0 (Aasm-toplevel-call)
environment.precompiles: KEVM OSAKA's precompile set (#precompiledAccountsUB(PRAGUE): no P256VERIFY at 0x100, MODEXP without EIP-7823/7883) differs from mainnet osaka; no proved path calls a precompile and GemJoin's CALL targets come from storage
environment.resource_limits: gas not modelled (<useGas> false): every claim holds for executions that do not run out of gas (Aasm-03). No claim guarantees termination within any gas limit; an out-of-gas halt is outside every claim. Within the gas-free semantics each all-path claim states that every path from Pre reaches #halt.

assumptions.name: semantics adequacy
assumptions.evidence: KEVM is the reference K semantics of the EVM; see semantics[0].adequacy_evidence (its own declared-failing list; no pass/total measured here)
assumptions.risk_if_false: a KEVM rule (including the OSAKA schedule rules and the stock EDSL [simplification] rules) that differs from mainnet osaka execution would make a proved claim false of the deployed contract, undetectably from inside the bundle

assumptions.name: KEVM OSAKA agrees with mainnet osaka on every opcode GemJoin's proved paths execute
assumptions.evidence: GemJoin uses no opcode introduced after Shanghai (linear sweep of the 3410-byte code section, CBOR trailer excluded: none of CLZ, BLOBHASH, BLOBBASEFEE, TLOAD, TSTORE, MCOPY; no SELFDESTRUCT, no BLOCKHASH), so the KEVM SHANGHAI/OSAKA differences reachable from its code are gas constants only, which no claim models. Record: provenance/opscan.json. The unmodelled osaka EIPs (7823, 7883, 7951, 7825, 7918, 7934) touch precompiles, tx- and block-level rules, none of which a proved path executes.
assumptions.risk_if_false: if an opcode on a proved path (CALLDATALOAD, SLOAD, KECCAK256, MSTORE, JUMPI, REVERT, RETURN, AND, EQ, ...) behaved differently on mainnet osaka than in KEVM, a claim could be false of the deployed contract

assumptions.name: BPO1/BPO2 blob parameters not modelled and not relied on
assumptions.evidence: mainnet at the pin is past BPO2 (eth_config blobSchedule {'baseFeeUpdateFraction': 11684671, 'max': 21, 'target': 14}); KEVM's schedule carries PRAGUE blob constants (Gmaxblobgas 1179648, Gtargetblobgas 786432) and no BPO forks. GemJoin has no BLOBHASH (0x49) or BLOBBASEFEE (0x4a) (provenance/opscan.json), and no claim models gas or block-level blob accounting
assumptions.risk_if_false: none for these claims as long as GemJoin's code has no blob opcode (checked by opscan); a claim about a contract reading BLOBBASEFEE would be about the wrong parameter set

assumptions.name: environment adequacy
assumptions.note: chain_id, fork (derived from the block) and external code hashes are compared with the chain at the pinned block; fee_schedule, caller_assumptions, precompiles and resource_limits are declared, not checked
assumptions.risk_if_false: the proof transfers to a machine other than the deployed one

assumptions.name: checker soundness
assumptions.note: kprove + Haskell backend kore-exec 0.1.155 + Z3 version 4.12.1 - 64 bit inside the image (CLAUDE.md pins z3 4.16.0 for the laptop toolchain; the image carries RV's bundled z3 4.12.1, which produced every verdict here)
assumptions.risk_if_false: an unsound prover step or solver answer could Accept a false claim; no proof object exists to re-check independently (variant A)

assumptions.name: artefact identity
assumptions.risk_if_false: the bundle would describe different bytecode; L0 reports a different artefact

assumptions.name: annotation discipline
assumptions.note: every lemma family / Aasm fact the claims depend on is listed in hard/annotations.json and closed mechanically (assemble_hard.py closure); their justifications are not checked
assumptions.risk_if_false: an unlisted assumption would be trusted silently

assumptions.name: spec well-formedness
assumptions.note: pre_witness replays concrete states satisfying the Pre of claim-02, claim-04, claim-05; every claim's antecedent is K-feasible (vacuity probes) and its opposite exit status is not provable (discriminators). Reachability (phi.json claims[].quantifies_over.reachability): claims 01-03 and 04 are reached by the deployed storage at the pinned block; claim-05's Pre (live == 0) is the post-cage() state, reachable by judgement only. claim-04: reachable, shown on chain: pre_witness claim-04 is the deployed storage at the pinned block with caller 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, whose wards slot reads 0 at the pinned block (eth_getStorageAt, recorded in claim-04-config.json chain_slot_checks); its instance Accepts and its vacuity probe does not
assumptions.risk_if_false: a claim over an unreachable Pre is true but says nothing about the deployed contract (a reachable-state trap: vacuity PASS does not detect it)

assumptions.name: simplification lemmas sound
assumptions.evidence: 320 rules in 6 families (all [simplification], checked by closure); the 4 Finding-0004 families probed with 4 known-false identities (none proved, laptop lemma definition, scripts/lemma-consistency.sh); BOOL2WORD/MAP-REASONING extracted verbatim from upstream lemmas.k; none machine-checked against the semantics
assumptions.risk_if_false: a false [simplification] rule lets kprove Accept a false postcondition; vacuity probes and program binding do not detect it (Finding 0004)

assumptions.name: KEVM keccak(Bytes) is Keccak-256; solc 0.5.12 mapping layout
assumptions.note: relied on by claim-04 for the MEANING of its Pre: storage[keccak(pad32(caller) ++ pad32(0))] is wards[caller]. The symbolic proof keeps keccak uninterpreted and needs no injectivity (nothing is written before the revert, so no two keys are compared). The claim-04 pre_witness evaluates keccak concretely (plugin) for caller 0x...dEaD and its wards slot was read from the chain at the slot cast computes (claim-04-config.json chain_slot_checks)
assumptions.risk_if_false: if KEVM's keccak or the assumed layout differed from mainnet, claim-04's Pre would constrain a slot other than wards[caller], and the claim would not say that non-wards cannot cage()

assumptions.name: storage words are 256-bit
assumptions.justification: SSTORE only ever writes a 256-bit word, so every storage cell of a reachable EVM state satisfies it; it is asserted in `requires`, not derived inside the claim (Finding 0003b caveat 1). Without it the #padToWidth fold does not fire.
assumptions.risk_if_false: none on a real EVM (SSTORE cannot write more than 256 bits); if KEVM storage could hold a larger Int, the getter claims would cover only states satisfying the bound

assumptions.name: addresses are 160-bit
assumptions.justification: Every EVM account id and CALLER value is a 160-bit address by construction of the machine.
assumptions.risk_if_false: none on a real EVM; the claims say nothing about a configuration with a wider id/caller

assumptions.name: gas not modelled: claims hold for executions that do not run out of gas
assumptions.justification: Standard KEVM functional-correctness configuration. Consequence: every claim holds only for executions that do not run out of gas. Out-of-gas is an exceptional halt (status EVMC_OUT_OF_GAS, all gas consumed), which is neither the EVMC_SUCCESS of claims 01-03 nor the EVMC_REVERT of claims 04-05; no claim guarantees termination within any gas limit.
assumptions.risk_if_false: a call with too little gas halts EVMC_OUT_OF_GAS, outside every claim (claims 01-03 say SUCCESS, 04-05 say REVERT); termination within a gas limit is not claimed

assumptions.name: top-level, non-static, zero-value call
assumptions.justification: Matches a direct external call. Not covered: execution via DELEGATECALL into GemJoin (then <id>/storage differ), STATICCALL (static=true), or a nested frame; R9 (callvalue > 0) is outside the claims.
assumptions.risk_if_false: a call with value, a STATICCALL, or a DELEGATECALL into GemJoin's code is outside every claim

assumptions.name: ABI argument words are 256-bit
assumptions.justification: A calldata word is 32 bytes, so every value it can hold is in range; #buf(32, X) is only the intended encoding for X in range. Excludes nothing a real call can send.
assumptions.risk_if_false: none on a real EVM: a 32-byte calldata word cannot hold a larger value

assumptions.name: image build purity
assumptions.note: the image kompiles the same K source tree as the laptop's kevm-1.0.678-lemmas2 (diff -rq identical, pilot/checker/STATUS.md) but with RV's Ubuntu K build instead of the nix build; patch was installed from an unpinned apt mirror if missing (pilot/checker/STATUS.md open problem 3)
assumptions.risk_if_false: the image's prover could differ in behaviour from the laptop toolchain that produced Findings 0003/0003b; mitigated only empirically (WS-C smoke reproduces the getter Accepts)
